title: Recover PR validation for preserved legacy archives
outOfScope: Do not change product behavior, test coverage policy, release metadata, tags, provider Releases, or v0.5.58 public assets.
Do not reclassify or rewrite any historical red or yellow Outcome.
Do not delete Dependabot branches or pull requests.

sources.reason: Existing PR aggregate regression coverage and the new reproducer.
Historical red Outcome that must remain immutable after preservation.
Historical yellow Outcome that must remain immutable after preservation.
Current cleanup archive that declares why the historical evidence is preserved.

rawUserRequest: Continue until all cleanup is complete; approve the minimal tested PR-aggregate repair for preserved legacy archives.

declaredIntent.summary: Repair fail-closed PR aggregation for explicitly preserved historical archives without changing release or runtime behavior.

riskAssessment.reason: The repair changes a PR gate, so it must accept only explicitly bound historical evidence and remain fail-closed for ordinary extra Work Items.

reasons: PR aggregation and archived Outcome integrity are trust surfaces.

override.approvalEvidence: The user approved continuing with the narrow tested repair until all cleanup is complete.
override.reason: Strict verification is required because the repair changes PR aggregation and archived Outcome evidence handling.
notRunChecks: Release publication checks are inapplicable because no release-owned resource changes and no version is published.

executionDecision.reason: The user approved the narrow repair and the acceptance criteria are executable.

preReviewWarnings: Review the negative cases carefully: a normal extra Work Item must still fail.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Preserve a verified pre-edit and pre-finish trail for this governance gate change.

acceptance: The actual PR-bundle reproduction containing preserved v0.5.56 and v0.5.57 archive evidence plus the reconciliation archive is rejected before the repair and accepted after it.
The new exception is evidence-bound: it requires immutable archived status, an explicit successor binding, and a current reconciliation source; a missing or altered binding fails closed.
An ordinary second new Work Item remains rejected by the exactly-one-newly-maintained-Work-Item gate.
The archived v0.5.56 red and v0.5.57 yellow Outcomes retain their original status and v0.5.58 is not republished.
The replacement Work Item completes archive, PR, merge, ai-close-work-item, and the final local/remote cleanup audit.
guidelines: Keep the exception narrow, deterministic, and fail-closed.
Preserve historical Outcome truth; never use a cache or a new receipt to impersonate completed verification.

intent.problem: The PR aggregate gate mistakes two preserved historical release archives for newly maintained Work Items, blocking the normal merge and lifecycle closure of otherwise completed cleanup.
constraints: No gate bypass or weakened exactly-one policy.
No mutation of historical Outcome status.
No new release or modification of v0.5.58.
intent.rationale: A source-bound archival provenance rule lets the repository keep failure evidence and finish cleanup while continuing to reject unrelated multi-Work-Item PRs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The PR aggregate check fails closed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An unrelated second new Work Item is present.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Existing aggregate regression plus focused assertion.
